seen_seq_required: Read the work activity stream and include seen_seq before writing.
write_interrupted: New work activity requires review before retrying this action.

work_project_read_only: Work cannot be created in a closed or cancelled instance.
requirement_version_conflict: The requirement changed. Refresh it before saving again.
requirement_frozen: This requirement is baselined. Content changes require a scope change.

requirement_limit: This instance has reached the limit of 500 active requirements.
criterion_limit: A requirement can have at most 50 active acceptance criteria.
client_choice: Choose either an existing client or a new client name.
primary_contact: Only one primary contact is allowed.
primary_accept: The primary contact must be allowed to accept deliveries.
repository_url: Use an HTTPS, SSH or git@host:path repository URL without credentials.
repository_name: Repository names must be unique within the project.
primary_repository: Only one primary repository is allowed.
project_code_taken: This project code is already in use.
project_name_taken: A project or client with this name already exists here.
parent_not_client: Choose an active client in this tenant.
provisioning_unavailable: Project creation is temporarily unavailable. No project was created.
contact_not_found: A selected contact is unavailable in this tenant.
intake_not_found: The source intake record is unavailable in this tenant.
member_role_mismatch: A selected member is inactive or cannot hold this project role.
project_limit_reached: This tenant has reached the limit of 500 unarchived projects.
human_only: Only a human member can create a project.
work_version_conflict: This work changed. Refresh it before saving again.
work_preparation_state: Preparation can only be changed before work is claimed.
readiness_no_human: An active Human accountable owner is required.
readiness_missing_method: Choose a primary verification method for this acceptance criterion.
readiness_high_risk_method: High-risk work needs TEST, COMMAND, HUMAN or VISUAL verification.
constitution_too_large: The constitution must not exceed 65536 UTF-8 bytes.
constitution_state: This version cannot be submitted or reviewed in its current state.
constitution_version: This constitution version changed. Refresh before trying again.
constitution_human_only: Only an active Human member can review a constitution.
assignment_state: The current project, work or assignment state does not allow this action.
assignment_held: This work already has an active executor assignment.
assignment_holder: Only the current Human executor may change their assignment.
assignment_readiness: Confirm the readiness warning before claiming a draft; ready work must still satisfy current readiness checks.
stage_transition_illegal: This stage transition is not allowed.
stage_criteria_unmet: The project does not yet satisfy the stage prerequisites.
stage_reason_required: Provide a reason of at least 10 characters.
verification_pending: Required verification has not passed for this exact result.
comment_conversion: This artifact comment cannot be converted; review the reason and existing target.
comment_context_required: Read the source work activity stream and include seen_seq before converting.
comment_interrupted: New work activity requires review before retrying this conversion.
readiness_requirement_conflict: The requirement contains a conflict that needs a Human disposition.
mode_same: The project already uses this team mode.
mode_transition_illegal: Switch to hybrid mode before enabling autonomy.
mode_preconditions_unmet: The project does not satisfy the autonomous mode prerequisites.
attention_session_closed: The attention session is closed or its sequence is invalid.
stage_delivered_requires_acceptance: Current client acceptance and terminal rework are required.
stage_close_open_work: Close requires terminal work, executions and deliveries.
archive_preflight: Project archive obligations remain unsettled or the preflight changed. Refresh and complete the resource dispositions.
deployment_evidence_mismatch: Deployment evidence does not contain the trusted merged commit.
defect_reopen_source_not_terminal: Only an accepted or cancelled defect can be reopened as a new BUG.
